_comment: The Message Centre contract shared by engine/ and Website/. The engine counts unread_sql over Kysely for the client's welcome screen; accounts.unread() in prisma/postgres/migrations/3_message_centre counts the same thing after resolving the username; the website counts it for the inbox. If the three ever drift the player sees a number in game that the site cannot explain, and nothing anywhere throws - so it is pinned here and copied into the website's own fixture.
unread_sql: count(*) from account_message where account_id = $1 and read_at is null
